aztecNoHorses: The Aztecs cannot train horse-mounted units; Early Tanks, Tanks and later armour are allowed
mongolSiegeReason: No Siege before the Medieval era.
mongolWallsReason: The Mongols raise Walls from the Medieval era

siege.builtInNote: ignores Walls, Castles and Star Forts (Industrial-era guns)
